WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
per AS (SELECT period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe, weeks_in_period w FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
stk AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.closing_units) units FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per
  WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe GROUP BY 1),
stk_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe),
sal AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores)) st_units,
         sum(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores)) other_units,
         sum(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores) AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) st_units_nostaff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(r.quantity_returned) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores)) ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe GROUP BY 1)
SELECT stk.category, stk.units, sal.st_units, sal.other_units, sal.st_units_nostaff, ret.ret_units, per.w,
  round(stk.units / (sal.st_units / per.w), 2) woc_gross,
  round(stk.units / ((sal.st_units - coalesce(ret.ret_units,0)) / per.w), 2) woc_net_of_returns
FROM stk JOIN sal USING (category) LEFT JOIN ret USING (category), per ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe, weeks_in_period w FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
stk AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.closing_units) units, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per
  WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe GROUP BY 1),
stk_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe),
sal AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.quantity) units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, stk.category, round(stk.units / (sal.units_sold / per.w), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stk JOIN sal USING (category), per ORDER BY stk.category
